description_en: Queries elastic compute units (ECUs) available for scaling out an application in a specified cluster or the cluster where the application is deployed. This operation is applicable to Elastic Compute Service (ECS) clusters
description_zh: 从指定集群或应用关联集群获取可用于应用扩容的ECU列表。该接口仅适用于ECS集群
kebab_example: aliyun edas list-scale-out-ecu --logical-region-id cn-beijing:test --cluster-id 52984524-6d48-4bbd-000000000000000000 --app-id b93024fd-8a9d-4ef7-99f1-5f0d65cc0000 --group-id 8123db90-880f-486f-0000-0000 --cpu 1 --mem 200 --instance-num 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListScaleOutEcu

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the namespace.

The ID of a custom namespace is in the `region ID:namespace identifier` format. Example: cn-beijing:test.

The ID of the default namespace is in the `region ID` format. Example: cn-beijing
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间ID。
自定义命名空间ID格式为：`地域ID:命名空间标示符`，例如：cn-beijing:test。
默认命名空间ID格式为：`地域ID`，例如：cn-beijing
parameters.name: logical_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster. Specify this parameter if you want to query the available ECUs in the cluster.

Specify at least one of the ClusterId and AppId parameters as the query parameter
parameters.help_zh:
以集群为查询条件，查询该集群内可用的ECU列表。

ClusterId与AppId需要至少填入一个作为查询参数
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application. Specify this parameter if you want to query the available ECUs in the cluster where the application is deployed.

Specify at least one of the ClusterId and AppId parameters as the query parameter
parameters.help_zh:
以应用为查询条件，查询该应用所在集群内可用的ECU列表。

ClusterId与AppId需要至少填入一个作为查询参数
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group. Specify this parameter if you want to query the available ECUs in the cluster where the instance group resides
parameters.help_zh: 查询该应用分组所在集群内可用的ECU列表
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of CPU cores based on which you want to query the available ECUs in the cluster
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: The size of available memory based on which you want to query the available ECUs in the cluster. Unit: MB
parameters.help_zh: 查询满足剩余可用内存要求的ECU，单位为MB
parameters.name: mem

parameters.help_en: The number of ECUs that you want to query. If this parameter is not specified, all the ECUs that meet the query conditions are returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询并列出指定数量的ECU，如果不设置则代表列出所有满足筛查结果的ECU列表
parameters.name: instance_num

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

AvailableCpu.description_en: The number of available CPU cores for the ECU

AvailableMem.description_en: The size of available memory for the ECU. Unit: MB

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the ECU was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC

DockerEnv.description_en:
Indicates whether Docker is installed. Valid values:

true: Docker is installed.

false: Docker is not installed
DockerEnv.description_zh:
是否安装了Docker：
true：已安装Docker。
false：未安装Docker

EcuId.description_en: The unique ID of the ECU. To query the ID, you can run the `dmidecode` command on the ECS instance that corresponds to the ECU
EcuId.description_zh: 这台ECU的唯一标识ID，可以通过在ECS上执行`dmidecode`获取

HeartbeatTime.description_en: The time when the last heartbeat detection was performed. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
HeartbeatTime.description_zh: 上一次心跳检测的时间戳

IpAddr.description_en: The private IP address of the ECU

Online.description_en:
Indicates whether the ECU is online. If the ECU is online, its corresponding ECS instance is managed in EDAS. Valid values:

true: The ECU is online.

false: The ECU is offline
Online.description_zh:
是否在线，且实例当前是否受EDAS管控：
true：在线。
false：不在线

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the ECU is located

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the ECU was last updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最后变更时间的时间戳

UserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the ECU belongs

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the ECU is located

ZoneId.description_en: The ID of the zone where the ECU resides

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
